command:
set -u
failed=0
for d in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  p="$d/.mount-hardening-test-$$"
  dev="$d/.mount-hardening-node-$$"
  suid="$d/.mount-hardening-suid-$$"
  rm -f "$p" "$dev" "$suid"
  cp /usr/bin/true "$p" && chmod 0755 "$p"
  "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1
  rc=$?
  printf 'noexec test target=%s rc=%s expected_nonzero=yes\n' "$d" "$rc"
  [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] || failed=1
  mknod "$dev" c 1 3
  dd if="$dev" of=/dev/null bs=1 count=1 >/dev/null 2>&1
  rc=$?
  printf 'nodev test target=%s rc=%s expected_nonzero=yes\n' "$d" "$rc"
  [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] || failed=1
  cp /usr/bin/id "$suid" && chown root:root "$suid" && chmod 4755 "$suid"
  printf 'nosuid flag and test-file mode target=%s options=%s mode=%s\n' "$d" "$(findmnt -no OPTIONS "$d")" "$(stat -c '%A %a %U:%G' "$suid")"
  case "$(findmnt -no OPTIONS "$d")" in *nosuid*) : ;; *) failed=1 ;; esac
  rm -f "$p" "$dev" "$suid"
done
printf 'behavioral_test_failed=%s\n' "$failed"
exit "$failed"

command:
set -u
failed=0
for d in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  p="$d/.post-reboot-exec-test-$$"
  dev="$d/.post-reboot-node-test-$$"
  suid="$d/.post-reboot-suid-test-$$"
  rm -f "$p" "$dev" "$suid"
  cp /usr/bin/true "$p" && chmod 0755 "$p"
  "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1
  exec_rc=$?
  mknod "$dev" c 1 3
  dd if="$dev" of=/dev/null bs=1 count=1 >/dev/null 2>&1
  node_rc=$?
  cp /usr/bin/id "$suid" && chown root:root "$suid" && chmod 4755 "$suid"
  opts=$(findmnt -no OPTIONS "$d")
  mode=$(stat -c '%A %a %U:%G' "$suid")
  printf 'target=%s noexec_rc=%s nodev_rc=%s nosuid_present=' "$d" "$exec_rc" "$node_rc"
  case "$opts" in *nosuid*) printf 'yes' ;; *) printf 'no'; failed=1 ;; esac
  printf ' setuid_test_mode=%s\n' "$mode"
  [ "$exec_rc" -ne 0 ] || failed=1
  [ "$node_rc" -ne 0 ] || failed=1
  rm -f "$p" "$dev" "$suid"
done
leftovers=$(find /tmp /dev/shm -maxdepth 1 -name '.post-reboot-*-test-*' -print | wc -l)
printf 'test_leftovers=%s final_failed=%s\n' "$leftovers" "$failed"
[ "$leftovers" -eq 0 ] || failed=1
exit "$failed"
